metadata.description: Full address of the private 1-to-1 site, e.g. https://<tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<site> (no trailing slash).

Valid.expression: @or(and(equals(outputs('Cmd'), 'Completed'), not(empty(triggerBody()?['SubmittedOn']))), and(equals(outputs('Cmd'), 'Closed - Not Submitted'), empty(triggerBody()?['SubmittedOn']), less(ticks(triggerBody()?['DueDate']), ticks(utcNow()))))
